title: Ethiopian Style Filo Pie
description: A sweet and savory pie filled with the flavors of Ethiopia, perfect for a snack or dessert. The combination of flaky filo crust and spicy Ethiopian spices is a match made in heaven.
instructions: Roll out the filo dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut the filo into squares, about 4 inches per side.
Place a spoonful of the spinach mixture in the center of each square.
Brush the edges with melted butter and fold the filo in half to form a triangle.
Place the triangles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the filo is golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Serve the pies warm, with a side of yogurt or tzatziki sauce if desired.
